es: Increased borehole diameter due to brittle failure and caving of the wellbore wall. This will lead to poor hole cleaning while drilling, and all other problems associated with enlarged holediameter. Reduced borehole diameter (creep) normally occur in weak (plastic) shales, sand- stones and salt. Some chalk formations (Valhal, Ekofisk) can also show such be- haviour.
